item: fixity shows rows without a stored hash as not checkable and follows a language change
summary: Settings -> Integrity counted rows with no stored hash (missing_hash) as diverged and called them evidence of tampering. They are now counted apart as not checkable with their own note, never shown with the hash computed now, and the verdict never reads all-match while any exist (R804). The result is drawn from the last report on data-i18n-dyn hosts and repaints on oo:langchange with no second audit; whole plural sentences x12 replace welded number+word pieces. No backend change, no rows rewritten. Consumer grep: the diagnostics bundle fixity.json is a raw dump with missing_hash and a per-row reason, so it folds nothing. runFixity leaves the frozen-renderer list (295).
